name: dev-flow
description: Requirement routing and delivery through issues, CI, review, and merge, with four bundled Matt Pocock skills adapted for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Requirements to reviewed and merged pull requests.
interface.longDescription: Routes intent and coordinates requirement agreement, specs, tickets, implementation, CI, independent review, repairs, and merge. Waits for user confirmation of ticket breakdown and final PR merge. Includes grilling, to-spec, to-tickets, and code-review adapted from a pinned upstream Matt Pocock revision. Project rules remain in AGENTS.md.
defaultPrompt: Use dev-flow for this request. Wait for my confirmation of the ticket breakdown and final PR merge.
